# Anatomy geometry core

`iso-kit.ts` and `LICENSE` are from [wheresryan22/anatomy](https://github.com/wheresryan22/anatomy), pinned to commit `dbf697a527bbf7d358668e1557cb1e35ff725d46` (MIT, copyright 2026 Ryan).

Only the framework-free geometry/SVG core is retained. No examples, React bindings, course material, WebGL stack, global skill paths, or runtime downloads are build dependencies. Site presentation uses `src/styles/anatomy.css` and the site's theme tokens instead of the upstream standalone page palette.

Read the upstream API/craft instructions when changing geometry. Keep the license and revision explicit when updating this file.
